description_zh: 一辆车在对向车道超车时，与正在左转的前车发生侧擦。ego 为超车车辆，NPC 为左转车辆。

source_snippets: A passenger car passed the Waymo AV and the vehicle directly behind the Waymo AV by crossing into and driving in the opposing lane of traffic.
As the passenger vehicle passed the Waymo on the left, the right side of the passenger vehicle made contact with the front left corner of the Waymo AV
TYPE OF COLLISION: B. SIDE SWIPE
evidence.reason: 超车车辆主动驶入对向车道进行超车，与正在左转的前车发生侧擦，驾驶决策具有测试价值，且可映射到现有junction_turn与adjacent组合。
